title: Claude optimizes more than 30 open models for biology
summary: In just under four weeks, Claude optimized over 30 models for structure, protein design, and genomics. They were on average four times faster with a small accuracy loss, and nearly twice as fast with identical outputs. It also created a low-memory mode for systems over 10,000 tokens on a single GPU node. Design results are in silico only, and comparisons are internal to Anthropic.

evidence.tested: Accelerated models were checked against their downstream tasks (for example structure prediction) and FlashPairformer kernels were compared with cuEquivariance (2.7-2.9x faster on triangle attention); design results are in silico with internal comparisons.
evidence.unknown: Design results have no wet-lab validation, large viral capsid predictions were incorrect, ColabFold kernels were not benchmarked, and the model is not reproducible.
evidence.ai_role: Claude wrote custom FlashPairformer kernels, optimized more than 30 models, built a low-memory Big mode, and ran autonomous protein binder design.
